title: רב תחליפא בר מערבא

paragraphs: Rav Tahlifa bar Ma'arava came to Babylonia: Ketubbot 8a. He taught before R' Avahu: Gittin 52b; Sotah 27a; Bava Kamma 33b; Bava Metzia 7a. He heard from Rav Hisda and told it to R' Avahu: Eruvin 54, end of side b. He heard from R' Yohanan and said it before R' Avahu: Berakhot 55a. R' Yohanan asked, and so forth; Rav Tahlifa from the West taught him: Menahot 14b. He spoke to Ravin: Mo'ed Katan 27a; Bava Batra 174b. Ravin asked him: Nedarim 56b.
